signing.label: Not Authenticode-signed
signing.evidence: The verified installer bytes contain no PE Authenticode certificate table. This does not establish publisher identity or independent security review.

highlights: Stronger encrypted backup and restore verification, recovery, and retention-safe failure handling.
More reliable Preview-to-Live identity, output recovery, display state, and editor draft retention.
Live Tools keeps identity, current context, Close, and recovery actions reachable while content scrolls.
Compact Resources exposes every category through a labelled, keyboard-reachable overflow.
Safer backup-worker startup retry and operation-owned cleanup.
limitations: The installer and application are not Authenticode-signed. Verify the SHA-256 and keep Windows protections enabled.
Fresh-profile clean installation, physical projector and reconnect testing, real media audio, and a 60-minute rehearsal remain incomplete.
Narrator, NVDA, and native Windows High Contrast checks remain incomplete.
Fresh second-Windows-user portable recovery remains unverified.
Backup and restore responsiveness did not meet the predeclared 500 ms target in retained evidence.
